integrity: The lower bound is a direct equivalence-class argument from the bounded-morphism back condition and properness. The matching upper bound is the published X-times-X construction, whose properness, bounded-morphism projection, and preservation of equivalence relations were inspected in the primary source. A finite checker reconstructs the equality construction and verifies its properties over a range of sizes.
scientific_limitations: The exact lower bound is for proper two-agent S5 bounded-morphic covers of the universal m-world S5 frame. It establishes worst-case optimality of the finite quadratic properization but does not classify minimum proper-cover size for arbitrary epistemic frames, non-S5 source relations, or higher-agent extremal instances.
title: Quadratic state blow-up is sharp for two-agent proper S5 covers
